item.title: Biblical Masculinity: A Call to Christ-Like Manhood in an Age of Confusion
item.description: The phrase “biblical masculinity” is gaining traction in churches, men’s groups and online forums. It urges men to embrace a distinctly Christian vision of manhood rooted in self-giving love. In a culture marked by confusion about gender roles, declining male participation in faith communities and widespread family breakdown, this vision offers a clear, counter-cultural path forward. item.title: UAE reports strike near Abu Dhabi nuclear power plant
item.description: The country is investigating the source of the strike, which it calls a "dangerous escalation".

item.title: Scotland rugby great Scott Hastings dies at 61
item.description: One of Scotland's best and most loved rugby union players, Scott Hastings, has died at 61.

item.title: Bus riders to Montgomery retrace old steps while fighting a new fight
item.description: Thousands of people rallied Saturday in Montgomery, Alabama, to push back against conservative states' efforts to dismantle congressional districts that helped secure Black political representation.

item.title: Ukraine conducts large-scale drone strikes on Russia, killing 4 and wounding 12 others
item.description: One of Ukraine's largest drone strikes on Russia killed at least four people, including three near Moscow, and wounded a dozen others, local authorities said Sunday.

item.title: Large-scale Ukrainian drone attack kills three in Moscow region, says Russia
item.description: Ukraine's president says the strikes are a "justified" response to deadly Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities.

item.title: How worrying is the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo?
item.description: An outbreak in DR Congo has been declared a health emergency, with almost 250 suspected cases reported.

item.title: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in DR Congo an international emergency
item.description: The agency added that the outbreak, with around 246 cases and 80 deaths, does not meet the criteria of pandemic emergency.

item.title: Personal decision for Starmer on whether to fight leadership contest, minister says
item.description: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy tells the BBC that the prime minister has "shown before that he's up for a fight" and she "wouldn't write [him] off".

item.title: One clinic tracks the heavy toll Trump's immigration crackdown takes on mental health
item.description: Zocalo Health, a clinic in Los Angeles, screens all its patients for depression, anxiety and suicidal thoughts. It documented a marked increase in those conditions since ICE enforcement actions began.

item.title: Forty-three arrests after £4.5m police operation to keep rival London protests apart
item.description: Serious clashes between Unite the Kingdom and pro-Palestinian protesters were avoided on Saturday.
